name: BFCL - Overall
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.accuracy, 1) AS "Accuracy (%)", res.correct_count AS "✓ Correct", res.total_count AS "# Total" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'bfcl' ORDER BY "Accuracy (%)" DESC, "# Total" DESC

name: BFCL - By Category
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, category_key AS "Category", ROUND((category_val.success::FLOAT / category_val.total * 100), 1) AS "Accuracy (%)", category_val.success AS "✓", category_val.total AS "Total" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(MAP_ENTRIES(res.category_stats)) AS c(category_key, category_val) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'bfcl' ORDER BY id, "Accuracy (%)" DESC

name: ComplexFuncBench - Overall
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.overall_success_rate, 1) AS "Success Rate (%)", ROUND(res.overall_call_accuracy, 1) AS "Call Acc (%)", res.successful_samples || '/' || res.total_samples AS "Tasks", ROUND(COALESCE(res.avg_completeness, 0), 2) AS "Completeness", ROUND(COALESCE(res.avg_correctness, 0), 2) AS "Correctness" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'cfb' OR results.config.benchmark = 'complexfuncbench' ORDER BY "Success Rate (%)" DESC, "Call Acc (%)" DESC

name: ComplexFuncBench - By Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, domain_key AS "Domain", ROUND((domain_val.success::FLOAT / domain_val.total * 100), 1) AS "Success Rate (%)", domain_val.success || '/' || domain_val.total AS "Tasks", ROUND((domain_val.correct_calls::FLOAT / domain_val.total_calls * 100), 1) AS "Call Acc (%)" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(MAP_ENTRIES(res.domain_stats)) AS d(domain_key, domain_val) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'cfb' OR results.config.benchmark = 'complexfuncbench' ORDER BY id, "Success Rate (%)" DESC

name: Tau2 - Single Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, res.domain AS "Domain", ROUND(res.pass_rate, 1) AS "Pass Rate (%)", CAST(res.score AS INTEGER) || '/' || res.max_score AS "Score", ROUND(res.time_used, 1) AS "Time (s)" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'tau2' AND res.domain != 'all' ORDER BY "Domain", "Pass Rate (%)" DESC, "Time (s)" ASC

name: Tau2 - Multi Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.pass_rate, 1) AS "Overall Pass Rate (%)", CAST(res.score AS INTEGER) || '/' || res.max_score AS "Overall Score", ROUND(res.airline_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Airline (%)", ROUND(res.retail_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Retail (%)", ROUND(res.telecom_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Telecom (%)", ROUND(res.time_used, 1) AS "Time (s)" FROM results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE results.config.benchmark = 'tau2' AND res.domain = 'all' ORDER BY "Overall Pass Rate (%)" DESC, "Time (s)" ASC
